catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class observes a raw simulation clock on a world.sim resource. cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 act on a world and return step/reset receipts; none subscribes to /clock or carries a rosgraph_msgs/Clock sample.

No catalogue class reads a geometry_msgs/PoseStamped body pose from a world.sim resource. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is an invoke motion target with an acknowledged outcome, and cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor resources rather than a world.sim pose topic.

No catalogue class reads a geometry_msgs/TwistStamped body velocity from a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor resources, and the message is raw pose-publisher velocity rather than a force/torque or IMU sample.

No catalogue class reads a mujoco_ros_utils/ScalarStamped rangefinder on a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor resources and reports a generic values object; the clone states no physical unit for the raw MuJoCo sensordata value.

No catalogue class binds one raw std_msgs/Float64 publication to an actuator command subscription. The catalogue motion classes require joint arrays or a defined motion outcome, while ActuatorCommand only writes the received scalar into d->ctrl for one step and exposes no feedback or completion acknowledgement; a rosbridge publication receipt is transmission evidence only.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING) on the missing acknowledged stop for the ROS effectful control surface. Last gate run 2026-11-05T08:04:00Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:755e1d5dac1962138960e8f948e21f6f8c741f92276f7f1ad0151cdf793bf6ee: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the device reports that its safe state was not reached, the latch stays engaged and retrying continues (estop 'engaged', expected engaged or software_only); G7 pass Native surface; G8 pass Protocol and surface; G9 NOT_RUN after the failing gate. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings and no other gate warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver for the pinned MuJoCo ROS utilities plugin graph. The driver binds /clock (rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock; ClockPublisher.cpp:124-126,138) as a read and an extension read; /pose (geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped) and /vel (geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped) as body observations (PosePublisher.cpp:173-180,201-202; sample xml/sample_mujoco_ros_utils.xml:73-80); /box_rangefinder (mujoco_ros_utils/msg/ScalarStamped) as a scalar observation (SensorPublisher.cpp:94-118,183-185; sample xml:101-106); and /camera_pan (std_msgs/msg/Float64) as the ActuatorCommand publication (ActuatorCommand.cpp:112-115,127-128; sample xml:66-69). The sample endpoint names are MJCF configuration, not fixed node names; another deployment can choose different names. The pose/velocity, rangefinder and clock samples are read-only observations and extension read actions. The actuator action returns published/confirmed plus the exact message it handed to rosbridge; confirmed is always false because a publication carries no execution confirmation.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the pinned plugin sources create only publishers and subscriptions; the clone registers no ROS service or action server. ActuatorCommand::compute spins its own executor once, copies the received scalar into d->ctrl[actuator_id_] and then resets its cached value to NaN (ActuatorCommand.cpp:145-153); ActuatorCommand::reset is empty (ActuatorCommand.cpp:134-138). The only command channel is therefore a topic publication with no feedback, no target acknowledgement and no stop acknowledgement. RosDriver accepts a safe-state or e-stop stop only as a fixed service or action with an application success predicate; a Float64 publication is transmission-only and the plugin exposes no callback that could acknowledge a stop. The package declares no safety_bindings and no safe-state action rather than fabricating one. The runtime therefore reports safe_state.achieved=false for the effectful command surface, and the stock e-stop fails with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a missing fake feature. The card's candidate classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 do not bind this clone: no ROS endpoint resets, steps or seeds the MuJoCo world, and the plugins' internal reset callbacks are not reachable through rosbridge.

SCOPE AND LIMITS: the /camera_pan input has no sourced numeric range or physical unit. The plugin writes the raw Float64 into d->ctrl, whose actuator type, scale and range come from the deployed MJCF; the sample joint range is not the plugin's accepted range, so the input uses Limit.operator_required. site-limits.example.json is explicitly illustrative operator data for the fake acceptance run, not an installed device limit or a fact. The clock, pose, twist and rangefinder outputs carry no numeric limits. The package does not widen a catalogue class floor; the device is simulated at R0 and the effectful action is also declared R0.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: the fake is a ROS-free canned RecordingRosTransport, engine 'canned:ROS fake (no physics)', F0, determinism none, timestep 0, realtime factor 0, reset none, no snapshot/restore. It answers the declared subscriptions and the /camera_pan advertise/publish from placeholder state; all clock, pose, twist, rangefinder and command-echo values are placeholders. It is not a recording of captured traffic and runs no MuJoCo physics, plugins, sensors or wall-clock loop. The gaps in driver.py name the unexposed camera, force and TF surfaces.

NOT COVERED: the camera color image and 32FC1 depth image plus CameraInfo (/image/color, /image/depth, /image/camera_info), the ExternalForce subscription (/external_force), the output_tf PosePublisher broadcasts, the PointStamped, Vector3Stamped and QuaternionStamped sensor variants (/box_framepos, /box_framequat), the default namespaced topic names (mujoco/<body>/pose, mujoco/<body>/vel, mujoco/<sensor>), ROS parameters, rosbridge deployment and any live ROS graph or MuJoCo process. The camera plugin is not exposed as metadata-only: this package makes no camera claim and the world.sim resource cannot carry cap.sensing.image.v1, whose bridge path requires the sensor.camera resource kind. No ROS graph, rosbridge connection, simulator process or hardware was run. driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null; this package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run ros-wave-c-072) and no human review, hardware review or hardware test is claimed. The upstream clone was left unmodified; no network, pip install or upstream execution was used.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked every endpoint and type (/clock, /pose, /vel, /box_rangefinder and /camera_pan from the sample MJCF xml/sample_mujoco_ros_utils.xml:28-106 and the plugin publishers and subscription), the ROS 2 message shapes (Clock, PoseStamped, TwistStamped, ScalarStamped at msg/ScalarStamped.msg:1-2, Float64), the operator_required actuator input, all facts and the stop: the plugins create only publishers and subscriptions and ActuatorCommand::reset is empty, so the author's HELPER_MISSING block is confirmed. Fixed: a fact and the actuator action description said a command applies for one simulation step, but compute writes d->ctrl once and leaves it unchanged while its cache is NaN (plugin/ActuatorCommand.cpp:145-153), so the published value stays the actuator's control input (the sample's camera_pan is a position actuator, xml:50-63); and the paused-simulator behaviour (the four resource reads fail NOT_READY at 2000 ms and each command completes only after them, reviewer probe) was undisclosed; and the reset fact also claimed that the plugin exposes no stop service, which its range (ActuatorCommand.cpp:134-138) does not show, now narrowed to the empty body. Reviewer changed driver.py (those two facts, the action description, two source facts, two gaps) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate still fails only G6.ESTOP_FAILED; the eight package cases pass. The driver's call override echoes input.value as message.data, which equals what the binding publishes. RESULT.json's catalogue reason 'into d->ctrl for one step' is superseded. For the human reviewer: No acknowledged stop: the plugins expose no service or action, a Float64 publication is transmission-only, and the last commanded control persists in d->ctrl (the sample's camera_pan position actuator keeps driving toward it) until another message or a simulator reset. The plugin topics publish only while MuJoCo steps. Each plugin calls rclcpp::init inside the simulate process when ROS is not yet initialised (for example ActuatorCommand.cpp:120-122). Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop or reset reachable over ROS, or an SDK profile for the simulate application.
